cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called that concert immersive, so I've put cushions all round my living room. Come to my birthday instead; you'll be surrounded.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Immersive means the musicians walk through the audience. It isn't about cushions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, moving through it. I'll bring the cake round while you choose the music.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I promised Jo we'd hear live singing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, live as well. Bring Jo and pick a song you both know. I'll follow you through the first verse, then you can have the cake.

reason: Make a specific misunderstood copied cue shape the Drive pursuit and let B's practical information determine each subsequent tactic.
